Hi Ari,

Thanks again for hosting the workshop on Oct 1–2. Quick note to align on arrivals and a simple gate-liaison playbook so we avoid brokered hold-ups at the terminal. Key asks:

- Final arrival windows and PNRs for the 8 delegates (we've got 5 confirmed, 3 pending).
- Any VIPs who need a private escort (we assume one VP will request vehicle pickup).
- Meal / dietary restrictions we should surface to the hotel.
- Who from your side will be the primary contact at the arrivals hall (name + mobile)?

Proposed Redwood plan (please confirm):
1) Assign a Gate Liaison per carrier arrival (30-minute buffer).
2) Backup liaison on 15–30 min standby; if delay > 30m we trigger rideshare pickup.
3) On arrival, liaison waits at gate or carousel and radios security if necessary — we will provide security credentials ahead of time.

I'm attaching a one-page draft itinerary and the on-call roster so you can see proposed coverage slots. If this protocol looks good, I'll finalize and assign Sean as primary for the first wave and Mina as backup.

If you prefer a short call instead, I'm free at 11:00 PT.

Best,
